title: Piccadilly Carriage House
meta_description: Escape to the serene charm of Piccadilly Carriage House, a beautifully appointed 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom carriage home nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- Two complimentary beach cruiser bikes- Full bathroom with walk-in shower- Full-size washer and dryer inside living area (off kitchen)- Premium linens, towels, and a starter set of toiletries- Smart TV and high-speed Wi-FiTucked away along the cobblestone lanes of Rosemary Beach and framed by the serene greenery of Kingston Park and the Butterfly Garden, Piccadilly Carriage House is the ideal retreat for couples, solo travelers, or small families seeking understated luxury and effortless coastal living.Spanning nearly 700 square feet, this beautifully appointed home accommodating up to four guests combines elevated design with thoughtful amenities — all just a short walk or bike ride from the beach and vibrant town square.Property Highlights:Elegant Living Space - The open-plan main level welcomes you with refined coastal décor, a cozy seating area, and abundant natural light. The fully equipped kitchen includes modern appliances and all the essentials for in-home dining. A dedicated work nook/office space easily balances leisure and productivity. A sleeper sofa comfortably accommodates two additional guests. Tune in for family movie night on the large smart TV.Private King Bedroom SuiteUpstairs, escape to your tranquil bedroom retreat featuring a plush king bed, smart TV, and serene ambiance for restful nights.Unbeatable Location & Community Amenities:- Located at the heart of one of 30A’s most coveted neighborhoods, you'll enjoy easy access to everything Rosemary Beach has to offer- Beach Access: Just a 9-minute walk or 3-minute bike ride to the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of the Emerald Coast- Pools Galore: Four resort-style community pools, including a heated pool for year-round enjoyment- Tennis & Fitness: Access to eight Har-Tru tennis courts and nearby fitness facilities for additional charge- Town Square: A quick stroll to the lively town center, home to boutique shopping, gourmet dining, coffee shops, and weekend marketsThe Piccadilly Carriage House also has a separate Piccadilly Cottage that can be rented in tandem with the Cottage at a 25% discount.Relaxed Luxury by the Sea - Whether you're savoring morning coffee on a park bench under the oaks or ending the day with a sunset bike ride along the Gulf, Piccadilly Carriage House invites you to slow down, unwind, and enjoy the best of Rosemary Beach in style.TDT-032398
